intro: D aneflay amaynut. Sseddayeɣ ameẓlu n usneḥbes n yiqeddacen ASHIKA Network d tebdart n yiqeddacen n Minecraft SABALISU, yerna sneflayeɣ aseɣẓan n uqeddac n Minecraft Storia.
about: Mazal d amaynut, maca ttaruɣ tangalt yal ass, yerna ttneflayeɣ
Sseddayeɣ ameẓlu-inu n usneḥbes n yiqeddacen
Isteqsiyen ɣef imeẓla-inu neɣ ɣef tetiknulujit ansuf yis-sen: init-iyi-d kan azul deg Discord
can_write: Ayen i zemreɣ ad aruɣ (ula d tangalt yexlaḍen)
anw_t: ASHIKA Network: iqeddacen seg 30 yen deg wayyur
anw_p:
D ameẓlu n usneḥbes i wid yebɣan ad sseddun aqeddac maca ur zmiren ara ad sexsren aṭas n yidrimen.
Bdu s cwiṭ, **seg 30 yen kan deg wayyur**.
sab_t: SABALISU: tabdart n yiqeddacen n Minecraft
sab_p:
Rnu aqeddac-ik n Minecraft ɣer tebdart, tafeḍ imdanen ara d-yuraren fell-as.
Yelha i yimuraren i yettnadin aqeddac, ula d imawlan yebɣan ad sbanen aqeddac-nsen.
storia_t: Storia: aseɣẓan n uqeddac i yiqeddacen imeqqranen n Minecraft
storia_p: D afurk n uɣbalu yeldin n Folia i Minecraft 26.2. S **Storia Cluster**, yiwen n umaḍal yezmer ad iteddu ɣef waṭas n yiqeddacen deg yiwen n wakud, ma d imuraren ttɛeddin gar-asen war agdil n usali.
storia_points: **Storia Cluster**: yiwen n umaḍal yebḍan gar waṭas n yiqeddacen, s tuqqniwin yettwawgelhen
**Relay n uḥraz**: relay wis sin yeṭṭef anɣal yeddren, ad yeṭṭef amkan n umezwaru ma yella iruḥ
**Amasal Linear**: amaḍal ad yeṭṭef azgen n tallunt deg uḍebsi
**Amaḍal deg RAM**, **Tick Guard**, API n izegrar i yisefka yettwabḍan, d wayen-nniḍen
